list.title: Batman, grappling gun
list.altText: Close-up of a LEGO Batman minifigure with a black cape and a grin, aiming a black grappling gun at the camera against a bright, blown-out background

list.title: Batman, up close
list.altText: Close-up of a LEGO Batman minifigure in sunlight, pointing a blaster towards the camera, framed by a dark round vignette

list.title: Sun on the water
list.altText: Low afternoon sun reflecting on a moat that runs along an old brick city wall, with autumn trees, a green meadow and a sky full of contrails

list.title: Train in a hurry
list.altText: A yellow and blue train blurred into a streak by a long exposure as it passes under overhead wires, with sharp office buildings and a parking lot around it

list.title: Path through the trees
list.altText: A leaf-covered path running straight through a tunnel of trees, with low sun shining through the leaves and dappled light on the ground

list.title: Where the roads meet the sea
list.altText: A rocky coastline on Tenerife where a highway on a viaduct, a covered road along the cliff and industrial piers with a yellow walkway all come together above deep blue water

list.title: Floor after floor
list.altText: Two tall grey residential towers on Tenerife, side by side against a blue sky, with lower buildings, palm trees and a parking lot in front

list.title: Fort in the grass
list.altText: A round brick fort with small arched windows and a grass-covered roof, seen across a field of tall green grass, with trees behind it and a few visitors on the path to its left under an overcast sky
